name: Collector Geeks
blurb: Collectibles fair in Hasselt and Sint-Truiden, Belgium for trading cards, retro games, LEGO, Funko and comics.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'COLLECTOR GEEKS 12-13 september 2026 6-7 februari 2027 17-18 april 2027 LOCATIES: Trixxo Arena Hass[elt]...'; nav link '6-7 februari 2027 (Hasselt)'

Homepage text: 'Extra locatie H27 Sint-Truiden'; nav link '17-18 April 2026 (Sint-Truiden)' sits alongside the page's own 'COLLECTOR GEEKS ... 17-18 april 2027' banner text, so 2027 (not the mistyped 2026 in the link label) is the correct year

notes: This is a small twice/thrice-yearly trading-card & collectibles fair (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, sports cards, retro games, LEGO, Funko, comics) rotating between two Limburg venues under one brand/ticket system, treated as one file with one edition per date per the two-shows-a-year rule rather than split by city. The September 12–13, 2026 Sint-Truiden date already passed before this 2026-10-05 check and is excluded. It is a vendor/dealer fair with no guest program (no guests/gasten nav link anywhere on the site), so guests is "none" for both editions. One nav link literally reads '17-18 April 2026 (Sint-Truiden)' while the page's own repeated banner text says '17-18 april 2027' — treated as a typo in the link label and used 2027, matching the banner and sitting in logical sequence after the Feb 2027 Hasselt date.
